source.title: Baelran - Dawnblade
source.name: Baelran
source.description: A noble, fearless Warrior who grows stronger as the battle goes on.

skills.name: Celestial Rise

description.raw: Passive. When a battle starts, Baelran gains a shield equal to 80% + 5% (SP-based) of his initial HP and receives 300% (HP-based) bonus max HP. This bonus max HP does not raise Baelran's current HP and decreases by 2% every second. When Baelran is restored to his max HP, he spreads his wings, deals 10% (HP-based) damage to enemies within 2 tiles, and enters Celestial Form. While in Celestial Form, the bonus max HP no longer decreases, and his normal attacks all strike enemies within a 1-tile arc in front of him. Baelran is unaffected while receiving bonus max HP and while transitioning into Celestial Form. Active. Baelran channels divine power into his blade, dealing 280% (ATK-based) + 40% (SP-based) true damage to all enemies within a 3-tile arc in front of him. He then restores HP equal to 40% of the damage dealt by the active strike.

skills.name: Sanctified Surge

skills.description_lite: Passive. Baelran gradually restores HP during battle. In Celestial Form, his attacks deal extra true damage with each hit.

skills.name: Wrath Cleave

description.raw: Baelran knocks his target into the air with an upward slash, dealing 180% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage. He then slams his sword down, dealing 300% (ATK-based) + 40% (SP-based) damage to enemies within a 3-tile rectangular area in front of him, knocking them down for 2s.

skills.name: Divine Dominance

description.raw: When Baelran enters Celestial Form, he fully regains the bonus max HP granted by Celestial Rise. If he is restored to max HP again, he enters an enhanced Celestial Form, dealing 10% (HP-based) true damage to enemies within 2 tiles and becoming unaffected permanently. When casting Celestial Rise, Baelran calls down Divine Light strikes on every tile within the affected area, dealing 6% (HP-based) true damage per strike. If an enemy is hit multiple times, the damage they take from each successive strike is reduced by 10%.
active: When Baelran enters Celestial Form, he fully regains the bonus max HP granted by Celestial Rise.
If he is restored to max HP again, he enters an enhanced Celestial Form, dealing 10% (HP-based) true damage to enemies within 2 tiles and becoming unaffected permanently.
When casting Celestial Rise, Baelran calls down Divine Light strikes on every tile within the affected area, dealing 6% (HP-based) true damage per strike.
If an enemy is hit multiple times, the damage they take from each successive strike is reduced by 10%.

text: Increases the damage dealt by each Divine Light strike to 8% (HP-based).
Increases the damage dealt by each Divine Light strike to 10% (HP-based).
When Baelran enters Celestial Form, he dispels all debuffs on himself an permanently increases his ATK by 10%.
Upon entering enhanced Celestial Form, Baelran calls down Divine Light strikes on every tile within 2 tiles of him, dealing 10% (HP-based) true damage per strike to enemies hit.

skills.description_lite: When Baelran enters Celestial Form, he fully regains the bonus max HP granted by Celestial Rise. If he is restored to max HP again, he enters an enhanced Celestial Form, becoming unaffected permanently and empowering his Ultimate to call down Divine Light strikes that deal true damage.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: The extra damage from Baelran's Sanctified Surge can also reduce the max HP of non-boss enemies by 70% of the damage dealt. This max HP reduction cannot exceed 40% of the target's max HP or 800% (ATK-based) of Baelran's ATK, whichever is lower. When fighting against boss enemies, this skill does not reduce max HP; instead, it causes them to lose 0.7% (HP-based) HP.
